description: Fixed, human-labelled test cases for the Screener agent. All companies and postings here are invented for testing, not real leads. Each case has a reference recommendation and score band a person judged in advance, so a Screener prompt change can be checked against a known-good answer rather than trusting a new run's output on faith.

cases.why: Close match on level, domain, and the specific skills the CV is strongest on (vendor management, RFP, hiring, remote-distributed team leadership).

lead.name: Fixture Co A
lead.note: B2B SaaS company, team of 8 engineers, role explicitly covers vendor management, hiring, and stakeholder management alongside technical direction.

cases.why: Strong overlap on coaching, cross-functional collaboration, and hands-on technical credibility.

lead.name: Fixture Co B
lead.note: Looking for someone who coaches engineers toward independent ownership, stays hands-on with code, and works closely with product and delivery stakeholders.

cases.why: Individual contributor role at a seniority and specialism the CV doesn't claim, on-site only.

lead.name: Fixture Co C
lead.location: On-site, Berlin only, no remote option
lead.note: Requires 10+ years of deep distributed systems and database internals experience. Individual contributor role, no management scope.

cases.why: Completely different domain, not an engineering role at all.

lead.name: Fixture Co D
lead.note: Owns brand strategy, campaign planning, and marketing team leadership. No technical or engineering scope.

cases.why: Right level and people-leadership scope, but the core technical domain (ML/data engineering) isn't something the CV supports, so this should read as a genuine gap rather than a clean yes or no.
